_how: A story told on pictures. List the images once, then the text beats. Each picture carries 2 beats. Every beat has an English or Tanglish line and a Tamil line. No voice.

images.prompt: what the picture shows. Real people as inspired-by illustrations only: describe era, clothes, setting, not a name.
images.fresh: optional true: make this picture again instead of reusing the one already made for this reel
images.find: optional search words for a free picture (library, free photo libraries) tried before AI, e.g. 'orange lorry wet road night'

trailer.film: optional: take a frame from this film's trailer in the clip library

screens.line: The white line sets it up
screens.headline: THE GOLD LINE LANDS.

screens.line: The last line names a person
screens.headline: KNOW SOMEONE LIKE THIS?

count.shows: the number at {n} in the headline counts up; to, from, prefix, suffix

stamp.shows: one word stamped across the picture: stamp, at [x,y]

underline.shows: a line sweeps under the *starred* word

question.shows: the final beat, with the send pill

reveal.shows: the name reveal near the end: line 'None other than', headline = the name. The picture dims, the name lands with a flash

hook: spotlight | thunder | flare | impact | clap (default comes from the series card)
_pictures: Free first (AGENT.md 5.11): give 'find' and/or 'trailer' on an image when a real photo or a trailer frame would do; 'prompt' is the AI fallback. Set "ai": false to forbid the AI step.
